programs.title: The Last Color
programs.desc: Choti, a young tightrope walker, wishes to pursue her education but struggles to make a living. She soon befriends Noor, a widow who yearns to play Holi but is forced to live a life of abstinence.

programs.title: Kuch Kuch Locha Hai
programs.desc: Praveen Patel, a 45-year-old married businessman, is tired of his religious wife though he loves her. However, things change after a younger actress wants to move in with him to prepare for a role.

programs.title: Mr. & Mrs. Mahi
programs.desc: Former cricketer Mahendra marries Mahima, a doctor with a passion for cricket. However, upon discovering her exceptional skills, he encourages her to pursue a professional career in the sport.

programs.title: Badla
programs.desc: Naina, a successful entrepreneur, gets caught in a web of accusations when her lover is found dead. Later, she hires a reputable lawyer to work with her on the case.

programs.title: Omerta
programs.desc: Ahmed Omar Saeed Sheikh, a British terrorist of Pakistani descent, plots the kidnapping and murder of Wall Street Journal journalist Daniel Pearl.

programs.title: Apna Sapna Money Money
programs.desc: Arjun and Shivani are in love, but Shivani's father will never let them marry each other. Later chaos ensues when Arjun enlists the help of his conman cousin, Kishan, to unite him with Shivani.

programs.title: Fukrey Returns
programs.desc: Bholi Punjaban is back with a vengeance for round two of mischief, mayhem, and a get-rich-quick extravaganza with Hunny, Zafar, Lali, and deja choo expert Choocha.

programs.title: Koi ... Mil Gaya
programs.desc: A young man with special needs is influenced by his father's scientific work. He encounters an alien who grants him extraordinary abilities and transforms his life.

programs.title: Chennai vs China
programs.desc: Aravind is a descendant of a martial arts expert, Bodhidharma. He must revive the fighting skills to stop Dong Lee, who comes to India to wage a biological war.

programs.title: Vivah
programs.desc: Poonam, a traditional young woman, gets engaged to Prem, a wealthy man. Their faith and love are tested when an accident occurs and leaves Poonam with first degree burns.

programs.title: Bengal Tiger
programs.desc: Akash, a simple man, falls in love with politician Gajapathi's daughter, Meera. However, on learning the identity of Akash's father, Gajapathi suspects that he wants revenge for a past transgression.
